# Interactions

The commands `mt help` lists under Interactions. More in [Interactions](../../../concepts/interactions.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`interaction-add-message`](#interaction-add-message) | Add a person's message to an interaction run (recorded as `--author-name`, else the saved default author, else you) |
| [`interaction-add-system-message`](#interaction-add-system-message) | Inject a system message into a live interaction run (guidance from the system, not a participant) |
| [`interaction-approve`](#interaction-approve) | Approve the tool call an interaction run is waiting on |
| [`interaction-attach`](#interaction-attach) | Attach to an interaction run and follow it until it ends (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`interaction-author-defaults-clear`](#interaction-author-defaults-clear) | Clear the saved default author: interaction messages and votes are recorded as you again |
| [`interaction-author-defaults-get`](#interaction-author-defaults-get) | Show the saved default author that interaction messages and votes are recorded as |
| [`interaction-author-defaults-set`](#interaction-author-defaults-set) | Save a default author for interaction messages and votes (honoured for API keys only) |
| [`interaction-delete`](#interaction-delete) | Delete an interaction (refused while it has live runs, an automation starts it, or another interaction may start it) |
| [`interaction-get`](#interaction-get) | Show an interaction by name: its kind, latest version and id |
| [`interaction-history`](#interaction-history) | List interaction runs, live and ended, newest first (of one interaction when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`) |
| [`interaction-list`](#interaction-list) | List the interactions in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`interaction-ps`](#interaction-ps) | List the live interaction runs in a namespace, oldest first |
| [`interaction-reject`](#interaction-reject) | Reject the tool call an interaction run is waiting on, with feedback the agent can redraft from |
| [`interaction-run`](#interaction-run) | Run an interaction and wait for it to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` (exits 1 if the run ends in Error or is Killed) |
| [`interaction-start`](#interaction-start) | Start an interaction without waiting for the run to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` |
| [`interaction-tool-result`](#interaction-tool-result) | Show the full result of one tool call in an interaction run, by its sequence number in the run's context |
| [`interaction-vote-no`](#interaction-vote-no) | Vote no, with a reason, on the proposal an interaction run is waiting on (recorded as `--author-name`, else the saved default author, else you) |
| [`interaction-vote-yes`](#interaction-vote-yes) | Vote yes on the proposal an interaction run is waiting on (recorded as `--author-name`, else the saved default author, else you) |

## interaction-add-message

Add a person's message to an interaction run (recorded as `--author-name`, else the saved default author, else you).

```text
mt interaction-add-message <process-id> [message] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |
| `<message>` | list of text, one or more values |  |  | The message, in quotes |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--author-name <value>` | text |  |  | Record it as this person; honoured for API keys only (default: the saved default author, else you) |
| `--author-id <id>` | id |  |  | Your own id for that person, any UUID; needs `--author-name` (default: all zeros) |

## interaction-add-system-message

Inject a system message into a live interaction run (guidance from the system, not a participant).

```text
mt interaction-add-system-message <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--content, -c <value>` | text | yes |  | The message text |

## interaction-approve

Approve the tool call an interaction run is waiting on.

```text
mt interaction-approve <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--approval-id, -a <id>` | id |  |  | The approval's id (default: the one the run is waiting on) |

## interaction-attach

Attach to an interaction run and follow it until it ends (exits 1 if it ends in Error or is Killed).

```text
mt interaction-attach <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--stream` | flag |  |  | Show each new reply as it is written; the conversation so far is shown first either way |

## interaction-author-defaults-clear

Clear the saved default author: interaction messages and votes are recorded as you again.

```text
mt interaction-author-defaults-clear
```

Doesn't need you to sign in.

## interaction-author-defaults-get

Show the saved default author that interaction messages and votes are recorded as.

```text
mt interaction-author-defaults-get
```

Doesn't need you to sign in.

## interaction-author-defaults-set

Save a default author for interaction messages and votes (honoured for API keys only).

```text
mt interaction-author-defaults-set <name> <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | The author's name |
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | Your own id for the author, any UUID |

Doesn't need you to sign in.

## interaction-delete

Delete an interaction (refused while it has live runs, an automation starts it, or another interaction may start it).

```text
mt interaction-delete [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Name of the interaction, or name@namespace (or give `--id` instead) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id |  |  | The interaction's id, instead of its name |
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## interaction-get

Show an interaction by name: its kind, latest version and id.

```text

```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the interaction |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## interaction-history

List interaction runs, live and ended, newest first (of one interaction when named, else of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`).

```text
mt interaction-history [name] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text |  |  | Only runs of this interaction: its name, or name@namespace |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--all, -a` | flag |  |  | List the runs of every namespace (ignored when a name is given) |
| `--state, -s <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs in this state: active (queued or running), waiting (on a person, an approval or a resume) or terminal (ended) |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `20` | Maximum number of runs to list (1-200) |
| `--cursor <value>` | text |  |  | The cursor a previous page printed, for the next page |

## interaction-reject

Reject the tool call an interaction run is waiting on, with feedback the agent can redraft from.

```text
mt interaction-reject <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--reason, -r <value>` | text | yes |  | Why it is rejected: sent to the agent as your feedback |
| `--approval-id, -a <id>` | id |  |  | The approval's id (default: the one the run is waiting on) |

## interaction-run

Run an interaction and wait for it to end; inputs as `--input-<name>` (exits 1 if the run ends in Error or is Killed).

```text
mt interaction-run <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the interaction to run |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--response-json-schema <value>` | text |  |  | A JSON Schema the answer must match, instead of the interaction's own |
| `--swarm-max-depth <number>` | whole number |  |  | At most this many levels of sub-interactions below this run, 0 for none (only ever lowers the interaction's limit) |
| `--swarm-max-concurrent <number>` | whole number |  |  | At most this many sub-interactions running at once (only ever lowers the interaction's limit) |
| `--swarm-max-total <number>` | whole number |  |  | At most this many sub-interactions started in all (only ever lowers the interaction's limit) |
| `--web-download-partition <value>` | text |  |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, to keep the web pages the agents read (default: the namespace's, else the tenant's) |
| `--stream` | flag |  |  | Show each reply as it is written |

Note: an interaction's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`, and the ones it marks required must be given. For an input called 'User Query', pass `--input-user-query` &lt;value>. When the interaction uses memory, each agent also takes `--loom-<agent>` (the loom it remembers with: its id, name or name@namespace) and `--gift-<agent>` (threads to hand it as it starts: &lt;loom-id>:&lt;thread-id>[,&lt;thread-id>...]).

## interaction-start

Start an interaction without waiting for the run to end; inputs as `--input-<name>`.

```text
mt interaction-start <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the interaction to start |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--response-json-schema <value>` | text |  |  | A JSON Schema the answer must match, instead of the interaction's own |
| `--swarm-max-depth <number>` | whole number |  |  | At most this many levels of sub-interactions below this run, 0 for none (only ever lowers the interaction's limit) |
| `--swarm-max-concurrent <number>` | whole number |  |  | At most this many sub-interactions running at once (only ever lowers the interaction's limit) |
| `--swarm-max-total <number>` | whole number |  |  | At most this many sub-interactions started in all (only ever lowers the interaction's limit) |
| `--web-download-partition <value>` | text |  |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, to keep the web pages the agents read (default: the namespace's, else the tenant's) |

Note: an interaction's inputs are passed as `--input-<name>`, and the ones it marks required must be given. For an input called 'User Query', pass `--input-user-query` &lt;value>. When the interaction uses memory, each agent also takes `--loom-<agent>` (the loom it remembers with: its id, name or name@namespace) and `--gift-<agent>` (threads to hand it as it starts: &lt;loom-id>:&lt;thread-id>[,&lt;thread-id>...]).

## interaction-tool-result

Show the full result of one tool call in an interaction run, by its sequence number in the run's context.

```text

```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |

|---|---|---|---|---|

## interaction-vote-no

Vote no, with a reason, on the proposal an interaction run is waiting on (recorded as `--author-name`, else the saved default author, else you).

```text
mt interaction-vote-no <process-id> [reason] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |
| `<reason>` | list of text, one or more values |  |  | Why you vote no, in quotes; the agents see it |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--author-name <value>` | text |  |  | Record it as this person; honoured for API keys only (default: the saved default author, else you) |
| `--author-id <id>` | id |  |  | Your own id for that person, any UUID; needs `--author-name` (default: all zeros) |

## interaction-vote-yes

Vote yes on the proposal an interaction run is waiting on (recorded as `--author-name`, else the saved default author, else you).

```text
mt interaction-vote-yes <process-id> [author] [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<process-id>` | id | yes |  | The interaction run's id |
| `<author>` | list of text, one or more values |  |  | The earlier way to name the author: &lt;author-name> &lt;author-id> (use `--author-name` instead) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--author-name <value>` | text |  |  | Record it as this person; honoured for API keys only (default: the saved default author, else you) |
| `--author-id <id>` | id |  |  | Your own id for that person, any UUID; needs `--author-name` (default: all zeros) |
